IDSA Guidelines Treatment/Management Patients with COVID-19
## _______________________________________________________________________________
## HOSPITALIZED DUE TO COVID-19
Refer to COVID-19 Pharmacological Inpatient Treatment Guidelines to determine
whether monotherapy or combination therapy with remdesivir and dexamethasone is
appropriate. For patients on dexamethasone with rapidly increasing oxygen needs
and systemic inflammation, add a second immunomodulatory drug (see
Immunomodulatory Treatment below)
Minneapolis VAHCS COVID Pharmacologic Inpatient Treatment Guidelines
## Remdesivir (IV):
Remdesivir 200mg IV once on day 1, then 100mg IV daily for 4 additional days
< AND >
Lab orders for monitoring remdesivir treatment (CMP, CBC with diff, INR)
## Dexamethasone (PO/IV):
Dexamethasone 6 MG PO q24h for up to 10 days
< OR >
Dexamethasone 6 MG IV q24h for up to 10 days

## _______________________________________________________________________________
## HOSPITALIZED FOR REASONS OTHER THAN COVID-19
Treatment is recommended for patients with confirmed mild to moderate COVID-19
and are at high risk of progressing to severe COVID-19.
Interaction checker for COVID-19 medications website link

## __________________________________________________________________________
Therapy:
## Immunomodulatory Treatment

MVAHCS recommends baricitinib over tocilizumab in patients on high flow nasal cannula oxygen or non-invasive ventilated patients that can take PO or NG. For patients who cannot take PO or NG, or for those who are mechanically ventilated, we recommend tocilizumab. These treatments are to be added on to dexamethasone, with or without remdesivir. Consult Infectious Diseases for more details.
[Baricitinib PO/NG/GT](baricitinib-eua-covid-19)
<OR>
Tocilizumab IV

## Preferred treatment, within 5 days of symptom onset:

## Inpatient

Paxlovid order sets below contain both inpatient and outpatient orders.
NORMAL RENAL FUNCTION (eGFR =/> 60 mL/min)
Paxlovid (Nirmatrelvir/ritonavir) 300mg/100mg PO BID for 5 days MODERATE RENAL IMPAIRMENT (eGFR 30 to < 60 mL/min)
Paxlovid (Nirmatrelvir/ritonavir) 150mg/100mg PO BID for 5 days SEVERE RENAL IMPAIRMENT including hemodialysis (eGFR < 30 mL/min)
Paxlovid (Nirmatrelvir/ritonavir) 300mg/100mg once on day 1 then 150mg/100mg daily for 4 days

### Alternative, within 7 days of symptom onset:

Remdesivir 200mg IV once on day 1, then 100mg IV daily for 2 additional days
< AND >
Lab orders for monitoring remdesivir treatment (CMP, CBC with diff, INR)

## Outpatient

Paxlovid (Nirmatrelvir/ritonavir) 300mg/100mg PO BID for 5 days Non-VA order for above
MODERATE RENAL IMPAIRMENT (eGFR 30 to < 60 mL/min)
Paxlovid (Nirmatrelvir/ritonavir) 150mg/100mg PO BID for 5 days Non-VA order for above
SEVERE RENAL IMPAIRMENT including hemodialysis (eGFR <30 mL/min)
Paxlovid (Nirmatrelvir/ritonavir) 300mg/100mg once on day 1 then 150mg/100mg daily for 4 days
Non-VA order for above

### Alternative:

INV-Molnupiravir 800 mg PO BID for 5 days
Non-VA order for above
